source: recompute experiment29 membership from pinned projections; keep all selected requests, including long inputs and future source failures
fetch: GitHub root tree at each exact selected base_commit; reuse experiment29 cache; two workers, per-request30s timeout,2MiB response and4KiB error caps; at least250ms spacing per worker; no script or source-code execution
validation: strict root JSON shape, complete nonrecursive tree, unique root paths and valid object ids; cache only validated successful responses; cache writes atomic via temp rename; unavailable or malformed responses remain explicit, never substituted
output: public aggregate availability and root candidate coverage per repository, response byte totals; local-only deduplicated repo/path/blob-id license candidate manifest and root cache; no selected instance ids or individual commit ids in public results
candidate_rule: same experiment29 LICENSE/COPYING/NOTICE root blob filename rule; candidate names are not license interpretation or clearance; record snapshots with no candidates for later nested lookup
scope: all selected root metadata only, not recursive source catalogs, license text review, model inference, training, evaluation completion or raw-data/HF publication
replay: cached aggregate and private candidate manifest byte-identical; original53-sample behavior preserved and replayed; injected fetch tests for cache reuse, invalid/truncated responses and bounded output
